name: worker evaluated thread
source: import { Worker } from 'node:worker_threads'; async function main(): Promise<void> { const worker = new Worker(`const { parentPort } = require('node:worker_threads'); parentPort.postMessage(42);`, { eval: true }); await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => { worker.once('message', (value) => { console.log(value); resolve(); }); worker.once('error', reject); }); await worker.terminate(); }
